evidence.quote: Nonetheless, inflation pressures continue to run high, and the process of getting inflation back down to 2 percent has a long way to go.
a strong majority of Committee participants expect that it will be appropriate to raise interest rates two or more times by the end of the year.
The labor market remains very tight. Over the past three months, payroll job gains have been robust.
But the bank stresses that emerged in March may well lead to a further tightening in credit conditions. The extent of these effects remains uncertain.
while continuing the process of significantly reducing our securities holdings
